subject: Acme private control plane: operator roles, SAML/SCIM onboarding
messages:
From: Priya Singh <priya@acme-corp.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP onboarding — initial idp/scim questions

Hi Ava / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're moving ahead with a private control-plane deployment (VPC peering) and need to lock down identity and operator access. Two immediate asks for the SOW and implementation plan:

1) SAML assertions: we need the attribute contract (name, email, groups, role claim) and any required audience/recipient fields for the SP.
2) SCIM: which endpoints Redwood expects (Users, Groups, Memberships), whether you support incremental syncing (delta tokens), and how you handle group->role mapping.
3) Service accounts / operator roles: we need a recommended mapping for three operator tiers (admin, operator, auditor) and guidance on provisioning via SCIM vs. manual.
4) Audit & log requirements: retention windows and whether token exchange/service-account usage is logged to the control plane audit trail.

I'm attaching our IdP metadata and a short SCIM requirements doc to speed review. Can we schedule a 30m sync this week? Our security team (sec_ops@acme-corp.com) will join.

Attachments: acme-sso-metadata.xml (SAML metadata), acme-scim-requirements.pdf (SCIM checklist)

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Director, Identity Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-16T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private CP onboarding — initial idp/scim questions

Priya — thanks for the clear list, very helpful. I've attached our private-control-plane identity checklist with the expected SAML attributes and the SCIM surface. High level answers inline below and we can walk through on call:

- SAML attribute contract: we require email (NameID or email), full name, groups (multi-valued), and a role_claim we call "rp_role". Audience must match the SP entity ID from your metadata; recipient should be the ACS URL in the metadata.
- SCIM endpoints: /Users, /Groups, /Groups/{id}/members. We support full and PATCH (RFC 7644) for incremental updates — we recommend using the delta token flow for large directories.
- Group->role mapping: Redwood maps SCIM group externalIds to control-plane role bindings. We will provide a mapping template (attached) for admin/operator/auditor.
- Service accounts: recommend provisioning via SCIM for lifecycle and rotation; for operators who need ephemeral elevated access we support short-lived service tokens minted via our private CP API. All service token issuance is logged.
- Audit retention: by default logs are retained 90 days; enterprise customers can configure longer retention via Dedicated or Private add-on.

Next steps:
- Quick 30m call to validate SAML attribute names and SCIM schema — how about Thu 5/18 10am PT?
- We'll prepare a role-mapping template and a canary rollout plan for the first 2 operator users.

Attachments: redwood-privcp-id-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Private CP onboarding — initial idp/scim questions

Quick internal notes before the call:

- SAML: confirm whether Acme will send groups as a semicolon list or multiple assertions; we should prefer multiple assertions. We need to ensure our SP metadata accepts both but prefer urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:attrname-format:basic.
- SCIM scale: Acme expects ~12k users, lots of group churn. Delta tokens + incremental PATCH will be mandatory. We should push for SCIM pagination pageSize <= 1000 and rate limiting guidance.
- Role mapping: create a mapping that ties Acme SCIM group externalId -> controlplane.role: {admin, operator, auditor}. For delegated admin we need to restrict on IP/networks (VPC) — check if their operator VPN egress will be static.
- Service accounts: our recommendation is to issue a service principal via SCIM with a linked secret stored in their vault and a corresponding control-plane operator binding. We must document the rotation cadence (30 days).

I'll bring the above to the call and capture action items.

- Ben

> Thanks again for the demo last week...

Ava / Ben,

Thanks for the checklist — this looks close to what we need. A few clarifications from our side after talking to sec_ops:

- Groups: we will emit groups as multiple attributes (not a single delimited string).
- SCIM: we will support incremental PATCH + delta token; our IdP team will provide a SCIM base URL and a client with delegated credentials.
- Service accounts: we prefer provisioning service principals via SCIM so we have lifecycle visibility.
- Network constraints: our operators will access the private CP from two fixed egress IPs behind a NAT gateway — we will share those on the call.

Attaching our SCIM schema export so you can validate attribute names. Call confirmed for Thu 2028-05-18 10:00 PT.

Attachments: acme-scim-schema.json

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Director, Identity Engineering
Acme Corp

On Fri, May 19, 2028 at 14:05 Priya Singh <priya@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> Ava / Ben, Thanks for the checklist — this looks close...

Thanks all — great call on Thu. Summary and proposed rollout plan below. Please reply if any item needs changing.

Summary (decisions):
- SAML attribute contract final: NameID=email, givenName, familyName, groups (multi-assertion), rp_role claim.
- SCIM surface: /Users, /Groups, PATCH for membership updates, delta tokens supported. Page size <= 1000.
- Service accounts: provision via SCIM. Initial rotation cadence = 30 days; long term we'll set to 90 days after trust established.
- Operator roles: mapping template attached (admin/operator/auditor). Admins require IP allowlist (we'll accept Acme NAT egress IPs).
- Audit: control-plane records service token issuance and operator actions; default retention 90 days for Private, extendable by request.

Rollout plan (canary -> ramp):
1) Week 1 (Canary): provision 2 operator accounts via SCIM, test SAML login and role mapping with 2 VMs behind the egress IPs.
2) Week 2 (Validation): increase to 10 operators, enable detailed audit collection, run simulated revoke/rotations.
3) Week 3 (Ramp): full operator provisioning and handoff to Acme SecOps; document runbooks.

Action items:
- Redwood: provide role-mapping template + SP metadata and SCIM rate-limit guidance (ETA 2 business days).
- Acme: provide final egress IP list, SCIM base URL, and test credentials.
- Joint: sign off on rollout plan and schedule a post-canary review.

Attachments: redwood-privcp-rollout-plan.docx

Thanks — will kick off the templates now.

Regards,
